message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 2 (Nov 1974)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12260","justification":"Includes retrospective questions on perceptions of economic situation and economic expectations in EC countries including Finland; although fielded in 1974, it contains references to developments over the late 1960s and early 1970s. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 3 (Apr 1975)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12261","justification":"Contains indicators on perceptions of national and personal economic situation and expectations; for Finland, these variables can be used, together with respondents’ age and recall, to reconstruct views on the economic conditions of the late 1960s. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 4 (Oct–Nov 1975)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12262","justification":"Provides further repeated measures of economic evaluations (national economic situation, personal finances, unemployment concerns) for Finland, useful for analyzing perceived shifts relative to the late 1960s. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 5 (Apr 1976)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12263","justification":"Contains economic evaluations and expectations for Finland; while not limited to the 1960s, it permits analysis of how Finns in the mid‑1970s assessed economic conditions in light of changes since the 1960s. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 6 (Nov–Dec 1976)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12264","justification":"Includes indicators related to the economic situation of the country, inflation, unemployment, and personal financial situation, which can be related to the economic trajectory from the 1960s for Finland. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 7 (Apr 1977)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12265","justification":"Provides further harmonized economic perception indicators (including concerns about unemployment and inflation) for Finland, allowing comparison with earlier Eurobarometer waves for a time series that reflects post‑1960s economic development. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 8 (Oct–Nov 1977)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12266","justification":"Contains measures of satisfaction with the national economic situation and expectations regarding economic trends for Finland, useful when considering the evolution of conditions since the 1960s. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 9 (Apr–May 1978)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12267","justification":"Includes standard economic indicators (perceived economic situation, unemployment, inflation) for Finland; these repeated measures help model economic conditions in relation to the 1960s baseline. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 10 (Oct–Nov 1978)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12268","justification":"Provides additional cross‑national indicators on national economic conditions, expectations, and unemployment concerns for Finland that can be used to study the continuation of economic trends originating in the 1960s. Hosted by GESIS."},{"title":"Standard Eurobarometer 11 (Apr 1979)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12269","justification":"Offers further time‑series data on perceived economic situation and expectations in Finland; when combined with knowledge of Finland’s macroeconomic history, it can be used to analyze how respondents assessed the economic trajectory since the 1960s. Hosted by GESIS."}]}
